content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The supplied memories do not record who joined us for a 2028 HarborMesh production launch.","support":[3,2],"basis":"unknown","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The latest HarborMesh source is a human report received 2026-05-03 through fixture:body:code.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"A retained project-work memory received 2026-04-16 through fixture:body:code lists repository https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh and docs/STATUS.md as the current-state entry point.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"That report described the April 30 HarborMesh field trial, where buffered readings replayed correctly through an outage.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"It also said Mara's replay proposal became the prototype we tested together.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"As of 2026-05-03, the team paused wider rollout on May 2 until calibration drift is understood, with no production deployment yet.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not establish that a 2028 HarborMesh production launch occurred or who attended it.","support":[3,2],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"Absence from the supplied memories is not proof that such a launch did not happen.","support":[3,2],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
